extraction.name: OpenThoughts3-1.2M
extraction.description: An open-source dataset for training reasoning models, containing 1.2 million examples across math, code, and science domains.
extraction.creator: Etash Guha, Ryan Marten, Sedrick Keh, Negin Raoof, Georgios Smymis, Hritik Bansal, Marianna Nezhurina, Jean Mercat, Trung Vu, Zayne Sprague, Ashima Suvama, Benjamin Feuer, Liangyu Chen, Zaid Khan, Eric Frankel, Sachin Grover, Caroline Choi, Niklas Muennighoff, Shiye Su, Wanjia Zhao, John Yang, Shreyas Pimpalgaonkar, Kartik Sharma, Charlie Cheng-Jie Ji, Yichuan Deng, Sarah Pratt, Vivek Ramanujan, Jon Saad-Falcon, Jeffrey Li, Achal Dave, Alon Albalak, Kushal Arora, Blake Wulfe, Chinmay Hegde, Greg Durrett, Sewoong Oh, Mohit Bansal, Saadia Gabriel, Aditya Grover, Kai-Wei Chang, Vaishaal Shankar, Aaron Gokaslan, Mike A. Merrill, Tatsunori Hashimoto, Yejin Choi, Jenia Jitsev, Reinhard Heckel, Maheswaran Sathiamoorthy, Alexandros G. Dimakis, Ludwig Schmidt
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset was created by sourcing questions from existing and newly generated datasets across math, code, and science domains, filtering for high-quality questions using LLMs, deduplicating questions, and sampling multiple answers per question using a teacher model.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Questions were sourced from 27 different sources for code, 21 for math, and 14 for science, including StackExchange, OpenCodeReasoning, OpenMath-2-Math, NuminaMath, and Organic Chemistry PDFs.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Questions were filtered using difficulty-based filtering with GPT-4o-mini for code, and response length filtering with GPT-4.1-mini for math and science. Exact deduplication was used for math and science, and no deduplication for code. Decontamination was performed against evaluation sets using Indel similarity and N-gram-based similarity.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Answers (reasoning traces) were generated by querying a teacher model (QwQ-32B) 16 times per question to elicit distinct responses.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: Answer filtering techniques such as majority consensus filtering, response-length-based filtering, and fastText classifiers were explored but ultimately not used in the final pipeline as no filtering strategy outperformed the baseline of using all answers.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Limitations include not exploring datasets for reinforcement learning, not exploring staged SFT or curriculum learning, and potential generalization deficits as distilled reasoning models still show substantial fluctuations on simple task variations.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training reasoning models via supervised finetuning (SFT).
